findings.finding: The adapter adds performer, action-performer, and author to the closed role set, contradicting the guide's exact closed vocabulary.
The verifier never validates the exact actor role at use[4]. It therefore accepts R92's quoted-speaker role even though that role is outside the canonical vocabulary.
R92 does not construct uses through adapt_actor and builder_use. It verifies already handwritten tuples, so the proposed deterministic adapter is not the path that produces the cohort.

The inherited emitter passes the handwritten exact actor role through to ActorAttribution.ActorRole and ContextMasters, except for an obsolete performer-to-action-performer rewrite. Invalid role vocabulary can therefore reach canonical compilation.
